Key performance indicator tile: value, target, difference to the target, optional sparkline (IND-103).

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.KPITile(value=84.6, label="KPITile (OEE)", target=85, unit="%")
```

The data of the picture (samples, history or drawing) is sent with the widget's methods,
not as traits: see the [widget catalog](../widgets.md).

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"control"`, `"indicator"` | `"indicator"` | host | "control": the user sets the value; "indicator": display only. |
| `size` | array | `[190,96]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `value` | number | `"nan"` | host | Current value of the indicator. |
| `target` | number or null | `null` | host | Target; null: no difference shown. |
| `higher_is_better` | boolean | `true` | host | Which side of the target is good (shown with ✓ / ✗). |
| `unit` | string | `""` | host |  |
| `format` | string | `"%.1f"` | host |  |
| `show_sparkline` | boolean | `true` | host | Draw the history as a sparkline. |
| `history` | integer | `30` | host | Number of values kept for the sparkline. |
